help.title: Help
help.lead: What to tap and what happens, for the owner and counter staff. Grey chips like [Billing > New bill] are the menu to open; boxed words like {Save bill} are buttons.
help.findPlaceholder: For example: receipt, backup, PIN, quotation
help.nothing: Nothing in help matches that. Try a shorter word, like bill, stock or backup.

steps: Open Tula. On the shop computer: the Tula icon, or `http://localhost:5000`.
Tap your name and type your PIN.
The first time, choose your own PIN: 4 to 6 digits. Easy PINs like 1234 are refused.

blocks.p: Five wrong PINs lock that person out for 5 minutes. Forgot the owner PIN? See [[pin|part 14]].
Language: tap {English} / {தமிழ்} at the top. Each person's language is remembered.

head: Role
Can
rows: Make bills and quotations, take payments, add customers (without credit terms), look up items, stock and customers
Look at bills, stock, items, customers and reports

blocks.p: The owner adds people in [Settings], under **People who use Tula**.

steps: [Settings] Business name in English and Tamil, address, GSTIN, state, phone, bank and UPI ID, invoice numbering. A yellow line at the top says what is still missing. Saving keeps every valid change and marks any that were refused, with the reason.
[Items & customers > Items] Add items one by one, or many at once with Excel ([[excel|part 11]]).
[Stock > Opening stock] The counted stock and its cost, or with Excel.
**Customers and suppliers**, with what they owed on the go-live day (opening balance), credit limit and credit days.
**Next bill number:** if you continue a paper bill book, set the numbering in Settings before the first bill of the year.

blocks.note: Order for an Excel go-live: items first, then opening stock, then customers and suppliers with their opening balances.

blocks.p: The rate chips at the top, for example {TMT bars ₹60.00/kg}, are the day's rates. The owner taps a chip, types the new rate and taps {Save}.
Items that follow the day's rate use it from then on. Each size's extra (for example +₹3 for 8 mm) is added automatically.
[Billing > New bill]

steps: Pick the customer: type a name or mobile number. Not found? {+ New customer} adds them right there. For walk-in customers, leave it on the walk-in account.

Add items: type the code or name. Enter the quantity in any unit the item has, for example 10 bundles + 4 rods, or 147.35 kg weighed. The rate fills itself: the customer's special rate, else the day's rate, else the item's rate.
Optional: site, vehicle number, discount, bill language.
Payment now: cash, UPI, bank or cheque, any amount. The rest stays on credit.
{Save bill}. Warnings (low stock, credit limit) ask you to confirm. The owner decides in Settings whether they only warn or block.

blocks.p: After saving: {Print / Save as PDF} (A4 or A5, set in Settings), {Share} (a picture of the bill for WhatsApp or a printer app) or {Share as PDF}. A bill with an amount due shows a UPI QR code the customer can scan.

blocks.note: **E-way bill:** above the limit, Tula reminds you to make one. The e-way bill itself is made on the government portal.

blocks.p: A price for a customer who hasn't bought yet. Nothing changes: no stock goes out, nobody owes anything, and it is not in any register or GST return.

steps: [Billing > Quotations > New quotation] The bill screen without the payment box, with an optional **Valid until** date.
{Save quotation}, then print it, {Share} it or {Share as PDF}. It is numbered `QT/26-27/0001`.

When the customer buys: {Make bill} on the quotation. It shows the quoted rate next to the day's rate. Tick **Keep the quoted rates** to bill at the quoted price. The quotation then shows *Billed* with the bill number, and can't become a second bill.

blocks.p: {Cancel} a quotation the customer won't take.

list: {Cancel} on the bill (owner, same day): the bill stays in the list marked *Cancelled*, its number is never reused, and stock and accounts are reversed. A bill from an earlier month is corrected with a return instead.
{Return} on the bill (sales return, credit note): pick what came back and tap {Make credit note}. Stock comes back and the customer's balance goes down.

blocks.p: [Billing > Receipts > New receipt] Pick the customer, the amount and how they paid, then {Save receipt}. Tula settles the opening balance first, then the oldest bills; you can change which bills it goes to. Money with no bill becomes an advance and is used on later bills.

list: [Billing > Outstanding] Who owes what, by age (overdue in red). {WhatsApp} opens a reminder in the customer's language with the amount and your UPI ID.
**Statement**: a customer's account for a period, to print or share.

[Purchases > Purchases] Enter the supplier's bill: items, quantity as per the mill weight, rate, GST, freight. Stock goes up and the average cost is updated. Mark *no ITC* when the GST can't be claimed. Goods sent back: {Return} on the purchase.
[Purchases > Supplier payments] Pay against their bills or on account.
[Purchases > Expenses] Rent, wages, electricity, loading, fuel… by head, with GST where there is a GST bill.
[Stock > Stock] Live stock and its value per item, also in the largest unit, for example *46 Bundle + 13.35 Kg* (≈ in front for calculated steel weights). Low and out-of-stock items stand out.
[Stock > Stock corrections] Weighbridge difference, scrap, damage, count correction, always with a reason (owner).

blocks.p: [Items & customers > Excel import & export] (owner)

steps: {Download Excel} for items, customers and suppliers, or opening stock. The file is today's list, so it is also the form to fill. Its *How to fill* sheet explains each column.
Change or add rows in Excel. Keep the headings in row 1.
{Import from Excel…} and choose the file. Tula checks every row and shows what it will add, change or leave alone, and any mistake with its row and column.
{Save} keeps all rows, or none if any row has a mistake.

blocks.p: Every report also has {Download Excel}.

[Reports] Day book, cash and bank book, sales and purchase registers, steel sales against the day's rate, stock summary, profit and loss, profit by bill / customer / item, GSTR-1 (Excel and JSON for your CA), GSTR-3B, CMP-08.
Pick the period, then {Print} or {Download Excel}.
Tula makes a checked backup every night (the time is set on the Backup screen) and keeps a month of them. Tap {Back up now} before anything risky.

steps: On the shop computer, install Google Drive for desktop and sign in with the shop's Google account.
In Google Drive's settings, choose **Mirror files**.
[Settings > Backup] On the card *Copy backups to Google Drive*, tap {Back up to this folder}, then {Back up now}.
Check once that the backup shows up in drive.google.com.

blocks.p: [Settings > Backup] Pick a backup, tap {Restore} and type the owner PIN. Tula first saves a safety copy of today's data, then restarts with the backup.

Another owner can reset it in [Settings], under **People who use Tula** ({Reset PIN}). With no other owner: on the shop computer, run the `reset-pin` tool as administrator. It sets the temporary PIN 1234, and the owner chooses a new one at sign-in.
Other people's PINs: the owner resets them the same way.

head: Way
What it does
rows: Tula runs on the phone with its own copy of the data. Bill anywhere, without internet or the shop computer; changes go to the cloud copy when there is internet. Set up once with the cloud address and access token. The phone's bills have their own series (M1, M2…).
Connect to the shop computer (Android app or any phone browser)
Opens Tula from the shop computer. Only on the shop Wi-Fi, while the computer is on.

blocks.p: On the phone, {Share} and {Share as PDF} replace Print.

blocks.note: Each phone's access token can have an end date. [Settings > Devices & sync] warns a week before it runs out; make a new one before then.

blocks.warn: Uninstalling the app or clearing its storage deletes the phone's copy, including bills that never reached the cloud. Check that *Changes waiting to send* is 0 first.

blocks.p: [Settings > Devices & sync] shows whether the cloud copy is up to date, the changes waiting to send, and which computers and phones share the data.
For a stolen computer or phone: {Mark as lost} on another device, then make a new access token and enter it on every device.

Items, customers and suppliers, categories and expense heads that were **never used** can be deleted ({Delete} on their screen; owner). Anything already on a bill, purchase, stock or balance can't be deleted: mark it inactive instead.
Deleted things wait in [Settings > Recycle bin], with who deleted them and when. {Restore} puts them back as they were; it is refused, with the reason, if it would clash with something added since.

head: You see
Do this
rows: "Cannot reach the shop computer" on a phone
Is the computer on, Tula running, and the phone on the shop Wi-Fi?
The screen says what to do. Billing keeps working meanwhile.
A red line at the top of a screen
Read it: it says what is missing or wrong, and where to fix it.
Tula does not open on the shop computer
Restart the computer; Tula starts on its own. Still not? Ask whoever installed Tula to check the install guide's troubleshooting part.
